meta.notes: Starts in 2000, the first full year after FDIC began recording branch openings, closings and moves (1999-08-02). changed_hands counts branches moved to another bank by merger (713) or sale (722), not as a closing plus an opening. area 'Metro' rows have county_fips null. Left out: towns outside the metro that FDIC filed under a metro county by mistake (Rocky Mount, VA is in Franklin County (51067), not Franklin city; Appomattox, VA is in Appomattox County (51011), not Franklin city; Jacksonville, NC is in Onslow County (37133), not Camden County).
